purpose: Outcome-blind paired development qualification of frozen EnvSolve v16, including context-scoped negative operation state, on a qualified DGX Spark host.
execution_revision_rule: Use a clean descendant containing only this preregistration and later frozen selection or schedule metadata; all algorithm, harness, config, evaluator, and selection hashes below must match.

checks: algorithm and harness hashes match this preregistration
full regression returns 410 passed, 1 skipped, and 61 subtests passed
EnvBench revision is clean and matches the frozen evaluator revision
a case-free OpenRouter provider probe succeeds with the frozen model identifier
host_admission_gate.failure_policy: Do not select cases. Repair only host portability or infrastructure, refreeze if any frozen file changes, and issue a superseding preregistration before selection.
host_admission_gate.mac_results_role: Development verification only; they do not substitute for Spark host admission.

shared_boundary.action_kind_provenance: identical and recorded for both methods
shared_boundary.negative_operation_observation_recording: identical; only treatment policy and guard can consume the typed state
shared_boundary.provider_acquisition: two bounded JSONDecodeError retries with per-attempt accounting

estimands.primary_system_contrast: Frozen constraint-driven EnvSolve v16 versus the frozen free-form operation ablation.
estimands.negative_operation_utilization: Within treatment trajectories, count hard operation/feasible=false admissions and matching-context guard rejections before environment allocation.
estimands.component_causality_limit: This broad system contrast does not isolate the negative-operation component; a dedicated treatment-component ablation is required for a component causal claim.

matched_primitive_limits.matching_basis: primitive limits; USD is an operational log field, not a matching variable or scientific outcome

config.portability_note: The historical filename is not a host binding; all paths are repository-relative and the exact content hash is frozen.

primary_outcomes: scientifically eligible paired runs and paired Official Boolean outcomes
internal-pass and natural Official-evaluator reach by method
paired Official success difference when both sides are eligible and Boolean
hard negative-operation admissions and pre-environment matching-context rejections in treatment
candidate command failure and validation rejection decomposition by method

mechanism_trigger.definition: Treatment admits a hard operation/feasible=false fact and later receives a proposal containing the same command under the same relevant typed prefix context.
mechanism_trigger.expected_consequence: Guard v4 rejects the proposal before a fresh environment is allocated.
mechanism_trigger.zero_trigger_rule: Report the mechanism as unexercised; do not replace cases, search repositories, or claim mechanism effectiveness.
mechanism_trigger.observation_without_later_proposal: Report admission only, not a guard opportunity.

qualification_rule.complete_batch: Run all five frozen pairs unless a shared boundary invariant fails or execution is interrupted under the rules below.
qualification_rule.insufficient_terminal_reach: Report terminal-reach insufficiency and use only failure decomposition; do not estimate method effectiveness.
qualification_rule.paired_comparison: Use only pairs where both runs are scientifically eligible and return Boolean Official outcomes.
qualification_rule.shared_boundary_failure: Finish the active pair when possible, stop the batch, consume all selected identities, and repair only with synthetic or consumed evidence.
qualification_rule.provider_acquisition_exhaustion: Record infrastructure Unknown, censor the pair, continue the frozen schedule, and do not replace the case.

adaptation_policy.zero_information_pre_episode_failure: One audited same-identity retry only when model, candidate, environment, command, evaluator, and method information are all zero.
adaptation_policy.partial_process_interruption: Mark the position scientifically ineligible without overwrite or rerun.
adaptation_policy.terminal_evaluator_infrastructure_failur: One evaluator-only retry of the identical script with zero new model calls.
adaptation_policy.host_suspension: Stop and classify affected or orphaned positions as scientifically ineligible without overwrite.
adaptation_policy.other_infrastructure_failure: Record Unknown and censor the pair without replacement.

claim_scope: development terminal reach, paired system qualification, mechanism utilization, and failure decomposition only
